limitations: Recommendation scores are calculator rules, not official game ratings.
Mount scoring uses a conservative manually reviewed mount list; unconfirmed new mounts are not scored as mounts.
The planner models species outcomes only and does not simulate mutations, passives, IVs, egg time, or probability.
One gender-dependent parent pair can produce two different children and is clearly labeled in results.
The dataset remains a v1.0.0 snapshot and was verified breeding-compatible with public patch v1.0.1 on 2026-07-17.
